references.text: The first census in the wilderness of Sinai where the Lord commands Moses to count all men from twenty years old and upward, who are able to serve in the army.
The age limit of twenty years and upward for the census is confirmed here.
The payment of ransom applied to everyone from twenty years old and upward, the same age limit as for the census.
Describes how the Lord led the children of Israel out of Egypt, as referred to in the verse.
The judgment on those who were twenty years old or older when they came out of Egypt, that they should die in the wilderness.
Repeats that those who were twenty years old or older when they left Egypt would not see the promised land.
The census at the building of the tabernacle which counted everyone from twenty years old and upward.
